summary: Full paired network-policy audit closed: directional permissions/DNS/peer traffic, Cilium/Calico/EKS APIs and safer operational checks corrected; bounded local evidence and runtime limits recorded.
findings: Clarified direction-specific isolation, both endpoint permissions, additive Kubernetes allows, ipBlock exceptions, node/hostNetwork/established-connection limits and CNI-dependent enforcement.
Replaced assumed namespace name labels with kubernetes.io/metadata.name; scoped Pod-based DNS to kube-system AND kube-dns, with TCP and UDP53 and explicit NodeLocal/AutoMode alternatives.
Completed frontend-to-API/API-to-database source and destination rules, same-team egress, database/data-tier peer ingress, DNS and bounded ports. Alternative profiles must not be combined blindly.

Removed current-schema-invalid Cilium Kafka L7 recipe; corrected HTTP/header authorization claims, DNS/IP learning limits, falsely named global default-deny and broad kubelet/world permissions; numeric identities are not permanent.

Corrected Calico NetworkSet labels, global() placement, workload-only namespace scope, Tier defaultAction/Pass behavior, and false Enterprise-only Tier/L7 assertions. Optional Istio/Dikastes integration was documented, not deployed.

Kept real EKS ClusterNetworkPolicy/ApplicationNetworkPolicy features, pinned their actual schemas, corrected enableNetworkPolicy string configuration and preserved existing addon config; failed reads/JSON now stop before update.

Replaced bare PostgreSQL deployment and aws-node deletion shortcut with explicit Pod-SG prerequisites and render-only CNI chaining. Clarified SG union/stateful returns, NACL stateless ephemeral returns and platform/SNAT limits.

Replaced false-PASS/fixed-Pod-delete test script with existing-Pod positive control and UNKNOWN/INCONCLUSIVE outcomes; timeout is not policy-drop proof. Inventory no longer hides API errors or misclassifies empty/allow-all/directional rules.
Distinguished Hubble visualization from policy editing, observed verdicts from delivery proof, licensed Calico UI and intrusive scanning from policy validation; archived Weave support is historical.

Reconciled all12quizquestions perlocale, removed Q7 duplicate correct answer, qualified scope/identity/DNS and preserved all156priorIDs with twoQ5aliases. LastUpdatedheaders record substantiveSeptember13verification.
